_readme: Every picture on the site is listed here by key. To add or replace one, save the image as src/assets/<file>.<jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif> (the extension doesn't matter) and rebuild. A missing file shows a placeholder that explains what belongs there. Run `npm run photos` to see what is still missing. Optional "fit": "contain" shows the whole image (good for screenshots and plots) instead of cropping it.

portrait.why: The first thing visitors see. It should feel friendly and confident.
portrait.framing: Portrait orientation, chest-up, natural light, outdoors or against a plain background. Look at the camera.

vest-wearing.alt: The vision-based haptic vest prototype with its chest-mounted camera
vest-wearing.what: You wearing or holding the haptic vest
vest-wearing.why: Shows the vest is a real, wearable build and that you made it.
vest-wearing.framing: Landscape. Vest, chest camera and motor layout visible; you can be in frame.

vest-detail.alt: Close-up of the haptic vest electronics: Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8 AI HAT+ and camera ribbon cable
vest-detail.what: A close-up of the vest electronics
vest-detail.why: Lets engineers see the hardware: Pi 5, Hailo-8 HAT, DRV2605L drivers and motors.
vest-detail.framing: Landscape or square, well lit, components in focus, cables visible.

vest-poster.alt: Rohan presenting the haptic vest at the SURP poster session, August 2025
vest-poster.what: You presenting at the SURP poster session (Aug 7, 2025)
vest-poster.why: Shows you explaining the research to an audience.
vest-poster.framing: Landscape, you and the poster or vest in frame. If you use the UAlbany News photo, get permission from the photographer or the News Center first.

coolant-poster.alt: Rohan beside the coolant level monitoring poster at the UAlbany Showcase, spring 2026
coolant-poster.what: You presenting the coolant level monitor poster at the UAlbany Showcase
coolant-poster.why: Shows the project and you explaining it.
coolant-poster.framing: Landscape, you and the poster in frame.
pages: Projects: Computer vision coolant level monitor

mesonet-hardware.alt: Prototype sound level meter: Raspberry Pi 4B, Dayton Audio iMM-6 microphone and USB audio interface
mesonet-hardware.what: The senior-design sound level meter hardware
mesonet-hardware.why: Shows the physical system behind the filter work.
mesonet-hardware.framing: Landscape. Pi, microphone and interface together; the reference meter beside it if possible.

msp430-game.alt: MSP430 electronic memory game with buttons and a thumbstick
msp430-game.framing: Landscape, from slightly above, board, buttons and thumbstick visible. Powered on if you can.

solfege-game.alt: Screenshot of the Solfège Light and Sound Memory Game
solfege-game.what: A screenshot of the Solfège memory game (or a hackathon demo photo)
solfege-game.why: Shows the hackathon project in action.
solfege-game.framing: Landscape browser screenshot mid-game, or a photo of the demo table.

nn-terminal.alt: Terminal output of the C neural network predicting an ASCII-art handwritten digit
nn-terminal.what: A terminal screenshot of NN-in-C predicting a digit
nn-terminal.why: Shows the from-scratch network working, ideally with the test accuracy printed.
nn-terminal.framing: Landscape terminal screenshot with the ASCII digit, the prediction and the accuracy line.

band.alt: Rohan with the UAlbany Marching and Spirit Band
band.what: You with the Marching & Spirit Band
band.framing: Landscape preferred, in uniform or performing.

community.alt: Rohan at the NSBE 2026 Annual Convention
community.what: You at an NSBE event or convention
community.why: Shows the community you're part of.
community.framing: Landscape, you plus the event setting. Ask anyone else in frame if they're OK being online.

hobby.alt: Rohan working on one of his side projects
hobby.what: You working on a side project, or doing something you enjoy for fun
hobby.why: Shows the curiosity behind the side projects and a bit of your personality.
